name: BTC transaction-count throughput + ADX trend — usage-confirmed trend (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why transaction throughput leads durability): confirmed Bitcoin transactions per day measures actual settlement usage — economic activity on the chain, independent of price, funding, and social hype. A trend that coincides with high/rising on-chain throughput is backed by real utilization and tends to persist; a trend on thin throughput is speculative and fragile. Throughput reflects organic demand that leads sustained price moves. We require btc_tx_count above a fitted floor AND adx above a floor (a real trend), riding it and exiting when ADX collapses. Distinct from the active-addresses specs (breadth of participants) — this is THROUGHPUT (volume of settlement). DISCONFIRMER 1: if ADX-trend alone matches the deflated Sharpe, tx-count adds nothing orthogonal. DISCONFIRMER 2 (non-stationarity): tx-count drifted structurally (e.g. inscriptions) so a fitted absolute floor can be always-true — the Gate must reject a degenerate level; the edge must be the usage regime. Data knowable T+1. tier1, low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: btc_tx_count is above a fitted floor (real on-chain throughput high) while ADX confirms a trend.
